text:
marcos_support: Hey team — new signup (marcos@example.com) didn't receive the free trial credits. Signed up via mobile web on iOS, used Venmo checkout. Email verification completed. Payments UI shows success but billing page shows 0 credits. Account: acct_0x9fA3

support-bot: Ticket created: #45231. Add any logs or repro steps here. :white_check_mark:

marcos_support: Repro steps I saw:
1) Mobile web -> choose Venmo -> completes checkout
2) Land on /console, click verify email link -> verification succeeds
3) Payments page shows "completed" but no free-trial grant in credits panel
No VPN, user is in Spain (ES).

sahil_payments: Can you paste the Venmo txn id and any provider reference? Venmo sometimes skips 3DS and triggers manual review. Also did we capture phone OTP?

marcos_support: Txn id: VENMO-644321-ES. Venmo flow so no card last4. No phone OTP in the flow. Email verify time: 2024-11-18T09:12Z. Screenshot uploaded to the ticket.

julie_ops: I can see an entry in the payments dashboard: hold present -> hold_reason=geo_ip_mismatch. Device IP came from a US CDN edge while billing region/phone indicate ES. That blocks the auto-grant.

sahil_payments: Confirming the hold from risk service. We can clear manually after a quick risk check. @ryan_sre can you eyeball infra signals? If low risk we can release and apply the free-trial grant.

sahil_payments: Logs (internal):
```
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' 'https://payments.internal/api/holds?txn=VENMO-644321-ES'
# response:
{ "txn":"VENMO-644321-ES", "status":"held", "reason":"geo_ip_mismatch", "created_by":"risk_service" }
```

ryan_sre: :thinking: Infra shows CDN edge in US but client timezone and user-agent suggest Spain. Account age 2m, no prior payments, low velocity. Approve manual release. Julie, please proceed with manual grant and note audit id.

julie_ops: Running admin grant now:
`POST /admin/grants {"account":"acct_0x9fA3","grant":"free-trial","amount":50}` -> 200 OK
Audit id: audit_78932. Also cleared hold: `DELETE /payments/holds/VENMO-644321-ES` -> 204. Should be visible in a minute. :lock_with_ink_pen:

marcos_support: I'll confirm with the customer. Thanks y'all.

marcos_support (follow-up): Customer confirmed credits appeared and they were able to call the API and generate embeddings. Closing ticket. :tada:
